'''Skua Squad''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]]<ref name="Sideshow Ganch" /> of nine<ref name="Squads" /> [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that served within one of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]]<ref name="Sideshow Ganch" /> [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]]<ref name="Squads" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Sideshow Ganch" /> 

Commanded by a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] and a [[Corporal/Legends|clone trooper corporal]] who acted as the squad's second-in-command,<ref name="Leadership" /> Skua Squad participated in a [[Skua Squad's botched mission|mission]] early in the war that was botched due to the squad's lack of discipline, leaving [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Ganch]] as its only survivor. Having witnessed what could go wrong when troopers lacked discipline, Ganch developed a hardened attitude and later became the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of the [[612th Attack Battalion]].<ref name="Sideshow Ganch" />

==Behind the scenes==
Created by [[Sideshow Collectibles]] for their ''[[Militaries of Star Wars]]'' line of [[Sideshow Collectibles|''Sixth Scale Figures'']], Skua Squad was mentioned as part of a [[2012]] action figure made exclusively for the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Celebration VI]] fan convention.<ref name="Sideshow Ganch" />
